lead_raw_text:
The structure of TeO₂ (Te₈O₁₆, 24 atoms per cell) is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Te centers in a tetrahedral environment of four O neighbors (about 1.82 Å), and O centers with two Te neighbors. The tetrahedra share corners, as do the O-centered 2-vertex coordination polyhedra. A 3-periodic geometric neighbor graph connects all 24 sites.
